name: JSON Path Tester
summary: Test JSON Path expressions against sample JSON and see matching values.
description: Paste JSON and a path like $.store.book[0].title or $.items[*].name. Matches appear instantly with dot keys, bracket indexes, and array wildcards.

faqs.question: Which JSON Path syntax is supported?
faqs.answer: Dot notation, bracket keys and indexes, and [*] wildcards on arrays.

faqs.question: Is my JSON sent anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. Parsing and evaluation run locally in your browser.
